name: Calci-Prime
headline: Calci-Prime
description: A source of natural calcium paired with the vitamins and minerals that help the body absorb it and support healthy bone metabolism.
howToUse: Adults and children over 14 – 2 capsules twice a day with food. Course: 1 month, repeated if needed.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
